title: iglo.base schema
description: Schema-as-code file of an iglo.base database: its collections, their fields, rules, indexes and auth settings. Editors use it for autocomplete and validation.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema dialect of this file. Editors use it to choose the validator; it has no effect on the database.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Collections keyed by name. A collection left out is not changed (system collections) or removed (others).

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: A collection of records. The type property selects a base, auth or view collection and the properties it accepts.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

system.description: Set only on a system collection that is not one of the five upstream ones (_superusers, _externalAuths, _mfas, _otps, _authOrigins), which are system by name. A file that does not list it keeps the default.

rules.description: API access rules of the collection.

indexes.description: Indexes on the collection's table. Each item is one CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX statement, for example CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_slug ON posts (slug).

fields.description: Fields of the collection, keyed by name and listed in display order.

authCollection.title: Auth collection
authCollection.description: A collection of records that can sign in, such as user accounts.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

system.description: Set only on a system collection that is not one of the five upstream ones (_superusers, _externalAuths, _mfas, _otps, _authOrigins), which are system by name. A file that does not list it keeps the default.

rules.description: API access rules of the collection, including the sign-in rules.

indexes.description: Indexes on the collection's table. Each item is one CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX statement, for example CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_slug ON posts (slug).

fields.description: Fields of the collection, keyed by name and listed in display order. The system auth fields are implied when not listed.

passwordAuth.description: Sign-in with an identity field and a password.

otp.description: Sign-in with a one-time password sent by email.

authAlert.description: Alert sent when an account signs in from a new device.

authToken.description: Lifetime of the sign-in token returned after authentication.

passwordResetToken.description: Lifetime of the token in a password reset email.

emailChangeToken.description: Lifetime of the token that confirms an email change.

verificationToken.description: Lifetime of the token in an email verification message.

fileToken.description: Lifetime of the token that grants access to protected files.

verificationTemplate.description: Default email that asks a user to verify the email address. Uses the {TOKEN} placeholder.

resetPasswordTemplate.description: Default email for resetting a password. Uses the {TOKEN} placeholder.

confirmEmailChangeTemplate.description: Default email that confirms an email change. Uses the {TOKEN} placeholder.

viewCollection.title: View collection
viewCollection.description: A read-only collection whose records come from a SELECT query.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

system.description: Set only on a system collection that is not one of the five upstream ones (_superusers, _externalAuths, _mfas, _otps, _authOrigins), which are system by name. A file that does not list it keeps the default.

rules.description: API access rules of the view.

query.description: SELECT query that defines the view. The fields of the view are the columns of the query result, so the collection has no fields or indexes of its own.

baseRules.title: Collection rules
baseRules.description: API access rules of the collection, one per action.

list.description: Rule for listing records. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

view.description: Rule for viewing a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

create.description: Rule for creating a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

update.description: Rule for updating a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

delete.description: Rule for deleting a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

authRules.title: Auth collection rules
authRules.description: API access rules of an auth collection, one per action.

list.description: Rule for listing records. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

view.description: Rule for viewing a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

create.description: Rule for creating a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

update.description: Rule for updating a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

delete.description: Rule for deleting a record. Null means only superusers; an empty string means everyone; any other value is a filter expression the record must match.

auth.description: Rule applied after a successful sign-in and before the auth token is returned, for example verified = true. Null disallows sign-in altogether; an empty string lets any record sign in.

manage.description: Gives admin-like permissions on a record, such as changing its password without the old one or setting verified directly. Applied in addition to the create and update rules.

fieldList.title: Field list
fieldList.description: Fields keyed by name, in the order they are listed. That order is the order used by the API and the dashboard. The system fields are implied when not listed: id, and for auth collections password, tokenKey, email, emailVisibility and verified. Do not write them unless they differ from their defaults.

field.title: Field
field.description: One field of a collection. The type property selects the kind of field and the properties it accepts.

textField.title: Text field
textField.description: A text value, with optional length limits, a regular expression and an optional primary key.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

min.description: Minimum number of characters. Zero means no minimum.

max.description: Maximum number of characters. Zero means the default limit of 5000.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match. Empty means no pattern check.

autogeneratePattern.description: Regular expression used to generate a random value when a record is created without one, or when the :autogenerate modifier is used. Generated values must still pass min, max and pattern.

primaryKey.description: When true, this field is the record's primary key. A collection can have only one primary key, and it must be named id.

editorField.title: Rich text (editor) field
editorField.description: An HTML value edited with a rich text editor.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

maxSize.description: Maximum size of the value in bytes. Zero means the default limit of about 5 MB.

convertURLs.description: Whether the editor converts URLs, for example removing the domain when a URL points at the same site.

numberField.title: Number field
numberField.description: A numeric value with optional bounds and an option to allow whole numbers only.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

min.description: Smallest allowed value. Null means no minimum.

max.description: Largest allowed value. Null means no maximum.

onlyInt.description: When true, the value must be a whole number.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

required.description: Requires the value to be true.

emailField.title: Email field
emailField.description: An email address, with optional domain allow and deny lists.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

exceptDomains.description: Domains that are not allowed in the email address. Cannot be combined with onlyDomains.

onlyDomains.description: Only email addresses on these domains are allowed. Cannot be combined with exceptDomains.

urlField.title: URL field
urlField.description: A URL, with optional domain allow and deny lists.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

exceptDomains.description: Domains that are not allowed in the URL. Cannot be combined with onlyDomains.

onlyDomains.description: Only URLs on these domains are allowed. Cannot be combined with exceptDomains.

dateField.title: Date field
dateField.description: A date and time, with optional earliest and latest bounds.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

min.description: Earliest allowed date and time, for example 2022-01-01 00:00:00.000Z. Empty means no minimum.

max.description: Latest allowed date and time, for example 2022-01-01 00:00:00.000Z. Empty means no maximum.

required.description: Requires a set date and time.

autodateField.title: Autodate field
autodateField.description: A date and time that the system sets itself when a record is created or updated.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

onCreate.description: When true, the current date and time is set when the record is created.

onUpdate.description: When true, the current date and time is set when the record is updated.

selectField.title: Select field
selectField.description: One or more values chosen from a fixed list of options.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

maxSelect.description: Maximum number of options a record can select. 1 means a single value; more than 1 means multiple values.

jsonField.title: JSON field
jsonField.description: Any JSON value, with a maximum size.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

maxSize.description: Maximum size of the JSON value in bytes. Zero means the default limit of 1 MB.

tsType.description: TypeScript type generated for this value, for example { tags: string[] }. Used only by generated types.

required.description: Requires a non-empty JSON value (not null, an empty string, an empty array or an empty object).

geoPointField.title: Geo point field
geoPointField.description: A geographic point with a longitude and a latitude.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

required.description: Requires coordinates other than 0,0 (the Null Island point).

relationField.title: Relation field
relationField.description: A link to records of another collection.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

collection.description: Name of the related collection. The file uses collection names, not ids.

cascadeDelete.description: When true, this record is deleted when all of its linked records are deleted.

minSelect.description: Minimum number of linked records. Zero means no minimum.

maxSelect.description: Maximum number of linked records. 1 means a single relation; more than 1 means multiple relations. Must be at least minSelect when minSelect is set.

required.description: Requires at least one linked record.

fileField.title: File field
fileField.description: One or more uploaded files, with size, type and thumbnail settings.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

maxSize.description: Maximum size of one uploaded file in bytes. Zero means the default limit of 5 MB.

maxSelect.description: Maximum number of files. 1 means a single value; more than 1 means multiple values.

mimeTypes.description: Allowed file MIME types, for example image/png. Empty means any type is allowed.

thumbs.description: Thumbnail sizes generated for image files: WxH crops from the center, WxHt from the top, WxHb from the bottom, WxHf fits inside the box, 0xH resizes to a height and Wx0 resizes to a width. Examples: 100x100, 0x300.

protected.description: When true, a file token is needed to access the file. Files are public by default.

passwordField.title: Password field
passwordField.description: A secret string stored as a bcrypt hash and never returned by the API.

description.description: Note for editors and generated types only. It is not stored in the database.

help.description: Help text shown under the field in the dashboard. It explains what the field is for.

hidden.description: When true, the field is left out of API responses.

presentable.description: When true, the dashboard uses this field's value as the record label in relation previews.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match. Empty means no pattern check.

min.description: Minimum number of characters. Zero means no minimum.

max.description: Maximum number of characters. Zero means the maximum of 71 bytes.

cost.description: bcrypt cost factor used to hash the value. Zero means the default cost; otherwise use a value from 4 to 31.

passwordAuth.title: Password authentication
passwordAuth.description: Sign-in with an identity field and a password.

enabled.description: When true, records can sign in with an identity field and password.

identityFields.description: Fields that can be used as the identity at sign-in, for example email or username. Each field should have a single-column UNIQUE index.

oauth2.title: OAuth2 authentication
oauth2.description: Sign-in with an external OAuth2 provider. The providers are listed here with their secrets as environment references; a plain secret is refused.

enabled.description: When true, records can sign in with an OAuth2 provider.

mappedFields.description: Fields that receive the OAuth2 user data.

providers.description: The OAuth2 providers of the collection. Listing them sets them from this file at every apply, and the secrets are read from the environment variables that the references name. Leave the list out to keep the providers the database has (for example, those set in the dashboard).

oauth2MappedFields.title: OAuth2 mapped fields
oauth2MappedFields.description: Names of the fields that receive the user data from the OAuth2 provider.

id.description: Field that receives the user id given by the provider.

name.description: Field that receives the user's full name.

username.description: Field that receives the user's username.

avatarURL.description: Field that receives the user's avatar URL.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: Second factor required after the first sign-in step.

enabled.description: When true, multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for the collection.

duration.description: How long an MFA session stays valid, in seconds. Must be between 10 and 86400 when enabled.

rule.description: Filter expression that limits MFA to the records that match it. Empty means MFA applies to every record.

otp.title: One-time password
otp.description: Sign-in with a one-time password sent by email.

enabled.description: When true, records can sign in with a one-time password sent by email.

duration.description: How long a one-time password stays valid, in seconds. Must be between 10 and 86400 when enabled.

length.description: Number of digits in the generated one-time password. At least 4 when enabled.

emailTemplate.description: Email that carries the one-time password. Uses the {OTP} placeholder for the password and {OTP_ID} for its id.

authAlert.title: Auth alert
authAlert.description: Alert sent when an account signs in from a new device.

enabled.description: When true, the record receives an alert email on sign-in from a new device.

emailTemplate.description: Alert email. Uses the {ALERT_INFO} placeholder for the details of the sign-in.

tokenOptions.title: Token lifetime
tokenOptions.description: How long a token of this kind stays valid.

duration.description: Lifetime of the token in seconds. Must be between 10 and 94670856 (about 3 years).

emailTemplate.title: Email template
emailTemplate.description: Subject and HTML body of an email the system sends. Placeholders in braces are replaced when the email is sent.

subject.description: Email subject. Placeholders such as {APP_NAME} are replaced when the email is sent.

body.description: Email body as HTML. Placeholders such as {APP_NAME} and {APP_URL} are replaced, plus the template-specific ones named in the property that uses this template.

oauth2Provider.title: OAuth2 provider
oauth2Provider.description: One OAuth2 provider. The name is the provider's (github, google, ...). clientSecret is an environment reference; the other keys are a value or a reference.

name.description: The provider's name, for example github.

clientId.description: The client ID the provider issued.

clientSecret.description: The client secret, as the environment variable that holds it. A plain value is refused.

userInfoURL.description: The user info URL (for custom providers).

displayName.description: The name shown on the sign-in button.

pkce.description: Whether PKCE is used. A reference holds "true" or "false".

extra.description: Provider-specific options. A reference holds a JSON object.

oauth2Value.title: Value or environment reference
oauth2Value.description: A text value, or the environment variable that holds it.

envReference.title: Environment reference
envReference.description: The name of an environment variable, read when the schema is applied.
